title: Cartwise Rewards Order Bonus Schedule
content:
Three order bonuses sit on top of base points in Cartwise Rewards — the pickup bonus, the weekly bonus and double points — and their figures differ by tier.

## Pickup bonus and weekly bonus

| Tier | Pickup bonus: points per whole dollar on Curbside Pickup orders | Pickup bonus: smallest qualifying spend | Weekly bonus: points for the first qualifying order of the week | Weekly bonus: smallest qualifying spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 0 | $0.00 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 0 | $0.00 | 25 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 1 | $25.00 | 50 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 1 | $25.00 | 75 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 1 | $25.00 | 100 | $35.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 2 | $25.00 | 150 | $35.00 |

At every tier the week used for the weekly bonus is the calendar week running Monday to Sunday, local time.

## Double points

| Tier | Double-points days offered per calendar year | Multiplier on base points on a double-points day | Most extra points one double-points order earns |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 2 | 2 | 500 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 4 | 2 | 750 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 6 | 2 | 1000 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 8 | 2 | 1500 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 12 | 2 | 2500 |

## Notes on the tiers

- At Cartwise Rewards Member and Cartwise Rewards Bronze the pickup bonus rate is 0 points per dollar, so a Curbside Pickup order adds no pickup points at those tiers.
- At Cartwise Rewards Member the weekly bonus is 0 points and the tier is offered 0 double-points days a year.
- The weekly-bonus spend threshold of $35.00 is the same from Bronze to Diamond; the pickup-bonus spend threshold of $25.00 is the same from Silver to Diamond.
- The double-points multiplier is 2 at every tier; what differs is the number of days a year and the ceiling on the extra points from one order.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical Curbside Pickup order with $40.00 of qualifying spend that is the first order of its Monday-to-Sunday week, the tier figures that come into play are: at Cartwise Rewards Silver, a pickup rate of 1 point per whole dollar (spend of $40.00 is above the $25.00 threshold) and a weekly bonus of 50 points (spend of $40.00 is above the $35.00 threshold); at Cartwise Rewards Diamond, a pickup rate of 2 points per whole dollar and a weekly bonus of 150 points. A hypothetical $30.00 order at Silver would meet the $25.00 pickup threshold but not the $35.00 weekly threshold.
